rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that is physically properly balanced or in equilibrium.

example.english: The two sides of this scale weigh the same, so it is really well-balanced.
example.traditional: 呢個天秤兩邊重量一樣，真係平衡。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 tin1 ping4 loeng5 bin1 cung5 loeng6 jat1 joeng6 zan1 hai6 ping4 hang4

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that someone's mental or emotional state is stable.

example.english: After treatment, they are well-balanced now and have no trouble going back to work.
example.traditional: 經過治療，佢而家精神穩定，返工都冇問題喇。
example.jyutping: ging1 gwo3 zi6 liu4 keoi5 ji4 gaa1 zing1 san4 wan2 ding6 faan1 gung1 dou1 mou5 man6 tai4 laa3

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that someone is mentally normal and not suffering from a psychological disorder.

example.english: They’re just a bit blunt; they’re well-balanced, so you don’t need to worry.
example.traditional: 佢只係講嘢直接啲，精神正常㗎，你唔使擔心。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zi2 hai6 gong2 je5 zik6 zip3 di1 zing1 san4 zing3 soeng4 gaa3 nei5 m4 sai2 daam1 sam1
